approaches.name: Concatenate and sort
approaches.intuition: Join the arrays and sort the result. Correct and short, but it ignores the existing order.

approaches.name: Two pointers
approaches.intuition: Because both inputs are sorted, the next output value is one of the two front elements.
steps: Output the smaller and advance its pointer
pitfalls: Forgetting the leftover tail after one array runs out.
Taking from `b` on ties is fine for plain values, but taking from `a` keeps the merge stable.

talkTrackMd: This is the merge step of merge sort. Say why it is linear (each element is written once) and why the leftover tail needs no comparison.
